text.p: Supertyphoon Yates will move westward across the central Mariana Islands, near Saipan, during the next 12-18 hours. Top winds will remain near 155 mph, and Yates will produce destruction due to the winds, as well as coastal storm surge and very heavy rain. Yates is expected to continue westward into the waters west of the Mariana Islands during the next couple days, slowly weakening with time. Yates is an extreme risk to shipping in the region.

Tropical Storm Zane is in the Philippine Sea near 17n/133e, moving west northwest at 20 mph. Zane is expected to continue this motion while slowing in forward speed during the next 36 hours. Zane has top winds near 50 mph but will likely reach typhoon strength by the end of this forecast period. Zane is not a threat to land but remains a threat to shipping.

Tropical Depression 9, 415 miles south of the Cape Verde Islands, will become an increasing threat to shipping this period as it tracks westward about 20 mph and strengthens. Top winds are 35 mph at this time but will likely reach tropical storm strength during the next 12 hours.
